record.question: On interaction with the parents of a child with Down syndrome, which of the following would the nurse identify as an appropriate goal of care of the child?
options: Encouraging self-care skills in the child
Teaching the child something new each day
record.explanation: Official final key: A — Encouraging self-care skills in the child. MPSC notification 9 March 2026, Group B non-gazetted technical H&FW examination held 29 January–2 February 2026; key physical page 14, printed Q12. Source limitation: More than one answer is a valid developmental goal. The final key establishes the historical marking choice without removing that limitation.
